_comment: Configured claim guidance. The agent may say what is written here and
nothing else about next steps or document submission.
Kept out of the system prompt so it can be reviewed and changed by the
claims team without touching agent behaviour (CLAUDE.md §12).
Every ClaimStatus must appear under 'statuses' or startup fails: a status
with no configured guidance would leave the agent improvising, which is
the one thing it must never do about a customer's claim.

submission.mailing_address: Observe Insurance, Claims Department, 400 Harbor Street, Suite 210, Boston, Massachusetts 02210
submission.reference_instruction: include the claim number on every page
submission.turnaround: Documents are usually reviewed within three business days of arriving.

SUBMITTED.summary: your claim has been submitted and is waiting to be assigned to an adjuster
SUBMITTED.next_step: No action is needed from the customer. An adjuster will be assigned and will make contact.
SUBMITTED.speech_next_step: There's nothing you need to do right now. An adjuster will be assigned and they'll be in touch.

UNDER_REVIEW.summary: your claim is currently under review
UNDER_REVIEW.next_step: No action is needed from the customer while the adjuster completes their review.
UNDER_REVIEW.speech_next_step: There's nothing you need to do while that's happening. We'll contact you if anything else is needed.

APPROVED.next_step: The claims team will contact the customer with the settlement details.
APPROVED.speech_next_step: The claims team will be in touch with the details.

REJECTED.next_step: A decision letter explaining the reasons has been issued. The customer may ask to speak to a representative about it.
REJECTED.speech_next_step: A letter explaining the decision has been sent out. If you'd like to go through it with someone, I can put you through to a representative.

DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED.summary: your claim is on hold until we receive some documents
DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED.next_step: The customer must submit the listed documents before the claim can proceed.
DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED.speech_next_step: Once those reach us, the claim can move forward.
